edges.reason: Both the NEW and EXISTING occurrences report 16 people wounded, citing the same official source (Interior Minister Ivan Vyhivskyi), but they are reported by independent news organizations (AP and Reuters).

edges.label: contradicts
edges.reason: The NEW assertion states "Two people were killed", and the EXISTING assertion states "killing three people". Since these are specific counts for the same event from different reports, and they differ, they are incompatible.
